; Nave home screen - v3.1 (polish pass: NAVE-SPEC-v2)
; Two-column home screen for My files (root folder, portrait, grid view):
;   - Side aisle: weekday + date, MY FILES folder list with counts, a plate
;     (random image from a folder on the tablet, 420 x 720) with a caption.
;   - Main column: CONTINUE row (three most recently opened documents), then
;     ALL DOCUMENTS with the stock sort control and the stock document grid,
;     forced to 3 columns of 286 px with black tile frames.
;   - The grid stops at a footer line (y 1870) so the stock search/+ pill sits on clean paper.
;   - Per-document progress bar under grid covers and in Continue.
;     Toggle it for selected documents from the selection bar's "More" menu.
; Anywhere else (subfolders, Favorites, Tags, Trash, list view, landscape) the
; home screen stays stock.
;
; Files on the tablet:
;   /home/root/.local/share/homescreen/plates/plates.json   (plate manifest)
;   /home/root/.local/share/homescreen/plates/*.png          (420 x 720, white bg)
;   /home/root/.local/share/homescreen/progress.json         (per-document bar choices)
;
; Replaces homeCards.qmd: remove homeCards.qmd before installing this.
; Coexists with fieldWeather.qmd and hideDevModeIcon.qmd (ContentHeader is untouched).
; qmldiff note: a binding value (outside a { } block) must not contain "!" (also
; "!=", "!==") or start with "("; such values are { return ...; } blocks.
; Checked with tools/qmd_lint.py.
; Target firmware: 3.29.1.0 (hashtab 3.29.1.0)
; Remove: delete this file from /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/ and run /home/root/xovi/start.
;
; Coordinates below are local to TreeExplorerView, which starts 120 px below the
; top of the screen (screen y = local y + 120).

; ===========================================================================
; Layout, aisle, plate, Continue row
; /qml/device/view/syncserviceexplorer/TreeExplorerView.qml
AFFECT [[3910876122537076124]]

    ; Item#root
    TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL INSERT {
            property var naveRef: naveLayout

            Item {
                id: naveLayout
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 50
                visible: naveLayout.active

                // ---------------------------------------------------- state
                readonly property bool active: {
                    if (root.width < 1400) return false;
                    if (root.height < root.width) return false;
                    if (typeof ViewManager === "undefined") return false;
                    if (ViewManager.activeView !== ViewManager.View.MyFiles) return false;
                    if (thumbnailSettings.thumbnailSize === ThumbnailSettings.List) return false;
                    if (root.explorer === null || root.explorer === undefined) return false;
                    return explorerView.currentFolder === root.explorer.rootId();
                }

                readonly property string serif: "EB Garamond"
                readonly property color ink: "#000000"
                // ALL DOCUMENTS line: stock header (120 tall) top edge; grid starts 120 below
                readonly property int headerY: 274
                // grid viewport ends here (screen y 1870)
                readonly property int footerY: 1750
                readonly property int mainX: 590
                readonly property int mainW: 970
                readonly property int colW: 286
                readonly property int colGap: 56
                readonly property string dataDir: "file:///home/root/.local/share/homescreen/"

                // ------------------------------------------- progress prefs
                property var prefs: {
                    return {};
                }
                property int prefsVersion: 0
                property var defaults: {
                    return {};
                }

                function defaultBar(ci, cc, ft) {
                    if (!cc || cc < 2) return false;
                    if (ft === Entity.FileType.Epub) return ci < cc - 1;
                    return ci + 1 < cc;
                }

                function barVisible(id, ci, cc, ft) {
                    var v = naveLayout.prefsVersion;
                    var d = naveLayout.defaultBar(ci, cc, ft);
                    if (id) naveLayout.defaults[id] = d;
                    if (id && naveLayout.prefs.hasOwnProperty(id)) return naveLayout.prefs[id] === true;
                    return d;
                }

                function progressOf(ci, cc, ft) {
                    if (!cc) return 0;
                    if (ft === Entity.FileType.Epub) return cc < 2 ? 0 : Math.min(1, ci / (cc - 1));
                    return Math.min(1, (ci + 1) / cc);
                }

                function pageText(ci, cc, ft, locked) {
                    if (locked) return "Password protected";
                    if (ft === Entity.FileType.Epub) return Math.round(naveLayout.progressOf(ci, cc, ft) * 100) + "% read";
                    if (cc > 0) return "Page " + (ci + 1) + " of " + cc;
                    return "";
                }

                // true when every id currently shows a bar
                function allShown(ids) {
                    if (!ids || ids.length === 0) return false;
                    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
                        var id = "" + ids[i];
                        var shown = naveLayout.prefs.hasOwnProperty(id) ? naveLayout.prefs[id] === true : naveLayout.defaults[id] === true;
                        if (shown === false) return false;
                    }
                    return true;
                }

                function setBars(ids, show) {
                    var p = naveLayout.prefs;
                    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) p["" + ids[i]] = show;
                    naveLayout.prefs = p;
                    naveLayout.prefsVersion = naveLayout.prefsVersion + 1;
                    var req = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    req.open("PUT", naveLayout.dataDir + "progress.json");
                    req.send(JSON.stringify(p));
                }

                function toggleBars(ids) {
                    naveLayout.setBars(ids, naveLayout.allShown(ids) ? false : true);
                }

                function loadPrefs() {
                    var req = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    req.open("GET", naveLayout.dataDir + "progress.json");
                    req.onreadystatechange = function() {
                        if (req.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
                        try {
                            if (req.responseText) {
                                naveLayout.prefs = JSON.parse(req.responseText) || {};
                                naveLayout.prefsVersion = naveLayout.prefsVersion + 1;
                            }
                        } catch (e) {}
                    };
                    req.send();
                }

                // ------------------------------------------------- plates
                property var plates: []
                property int plateIndex: -1
                readonly property string plateFile: {
                    if (naveLayout.plateIndex < 0 || naveLayout.plateIndex >= naveLayout.plates.length) return "";
                    return naveLayout.plates[naveLayout.plateIndex].file || "";
                }
                readonly property string plateCaption: {
                    if (naveLayout.plateIndex < 0 || naveLayout.plateIndex >= naveLayout.plates.length) return "";
                    return naveLayout.plates[naveLayout.plateIndex].caption || "";
                }

                function pickPlate() {
                    var n = naveLayout.plates.length;
                    if (n === 0) { naveLayout.plateIndex = -1; return; }
                    if (n === 1) { naveLayout.plateIndex = 0; return; }
                    var k = Math.floor(Math.random() * (n - 1));
                    if (k >= naveLayout.plateIndex && naveLayout.plateIndex >= 0) k = k + 1;
                    naveLayout.plateIndex = k;
                }

                function loadPlates() {
                    var req = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    req.open("GET", naveLayout.dataDir + "plates/plates.json");
                    req.onreadystatechange = function() {
                        if (req.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
                        try {
                            var j = JSON.parse(req.responseText);
                            naveLayout.plates = (j && j.plates) ? j.plates : [];
                        } catch (e) {
                            naveLayout.plates = [];
                        }
                        naveLayout.pickPlate();
                    };
                    req.send();
                }

                // ---------------------------------------------------- date
                property string weekday: ""
                property string dateLine: ""
                function updateDate() {
                    var d = new Date();
                    var w = Qt.formatDate(d, "dddd").toUpperCase();
                    var l = Qt.formatDate(d, "MMMM d");
                    if (w !== naveLayout.weekday) naveLayout.weekday = w;
                    if (l !== naveLayout.dateLine) naveLayout.dateLine = l;
                }

                Timer {
                    interval: 60000
                    running: true
                    repeat: true
                    onTriggered: naveLayout.updateDate()
                }

                Connections {
                    target: {
                        if (typeof BatteryManager === "undefined") return null;
                        return BatteryManager;
                    }
                    ignoreUnknownSignals: true
                    function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
                        var wasAsleep = previous === BatteryManager.DeepSleep || previous === BatteryManager.LightSleep;
                        if (wasAsleep && next === BatteryManager.Normal) {
                            naveLayout.updateDate();
                            naveLayout.loadPlates();
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Moves the stock "My files" header onto the ALL DOCUMENTS line and
                // fits the stock grid into the main column, ending at the footer line.
                // The grid is 3 x (286 + 56) = 1026 wide so that exactly 3 cells fit;
                // the last 56 px are the trailing gap. All bindings return the stock
                // values when Nave is not active.
                Component.onCompleted: {
                    var vhm = Values.viewHorizontalMargin;
                    var gm = Values.designGridMargin;
                    explorerHeader.anchors.topMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveLayout.active ? naveLayout.headerY : 0; });
                    explorerHeader.anchors.leftMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveLayout.active ? naveLayout.mainX - 10 : vhm; });
                    explorerHeader.anchors.rightMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveLayout.active ? 45 : -gm; });
                    var content = explorerView.parent;
                    if (content) {
                        content.anchors.leftMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveLayout.active ? naveLayout.mainX - vhm : 0; });
                        content.anchors.rightMargin = Qt.binding(function() {
                            return naveLayout.active ? root.width - naveLayout.mainX - 3 * (naveLayout.colW + naveLayout.colGap) - vhm : 0;
                        });
                        content.anchors.bottomMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveLayout.active ? Math.max(0, root.height - naveLayout.footerY) : 0; });
                    }
                    naveLayout.updateDate();
                    naveLayout.loadPrefs();
                    naveLayout.loadPlates();
                }

                // ------------------------------------------------- models
                EntitySortedListModel {
                    id: naveFolders
                    typeFilter: EntitySortedListModel.Filter.Folder
                    sortType: EntitySortedListModel.SortType.Alphabetically
                    currentSortOrder: Qt.DescendingOrder
                    model: root.currentModel
                }

                EntitySortedListModel {
                    id: naveRecent
                    typeFilter: EntitySortedListModel.Filter.AllNonFolders
                    sortType: EntitySortedListModel.SortType.LastOpened
                    currentSortOrder: Qt.DescendingOrder
                    model: root.currentModel
                }

                // Folder glyph, used through Loaders
                Component {
                    id: naveFolderGlyph
                    Canvas {
                        width: 34
                        height: 28
                        onPaint: {
                            var c = getContext("2d");
                            c.reset();
                            c.lineWidth = 2.5;
                            c.lineJoin = "round";
                            c.strokeStyle = "#000000";
                            c.beginPath();
                            c.moveTo(2, 4);
                            c.lineTo(12, 4);
                            c.lineTo(15, 8);
                            c.lineTo(32, 8);
                            c.lineTo(32, 26);
                            c.lineTo(2, 26);
                            c.closePath();
                            c.stroke();
                        }
                    }
                }

                // ================================================== AISLE
                Rectangle {
                    id: naveAisle
                    x: 0
                    y: 0
                    width: 560
                    height: naveLayout.footerY
                    color: "white"

                    // swallow taps on empty aisle space
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

                    Text {
                        id: naveWeekday
                        x: 60
                        y: 56
                        text: naveLayout.weekday
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                        font.family: naveLayout.serif
                        font.pixelSize: 26
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        font.letterSpacing: 8
                    }

                    Text {
                        id: naveDate
                        x: 56
                        y: 94
                        width: 440
                        text: naveLayout.dateLine
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                        font.family: naveLayout.serif
                        font.pixelSize: 76
                        fontSizeMode: Text.HorizontalFit
                        minimumPixelSize: 48
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        x: 60
                        y: 217
                        width: 420
                        height: 2
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                    }

                    Text {
                        x: 60
                        y: 254
                        text: "MY FILES"
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                        font.family: naveLayout.serif
                        font.pixelSize: 26
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        font.letterSpacing: 8
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        x: 60
                        y: 308
                        width: 420
                        height: 2
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                    }

                    Flickable {
                        id: naveFolderList
                        x: 60
                        y: 310
                        width: 420
                        height: {
                            var room = naveLayout.footerY - 310 - 20;
                            return Math.min(naveFolderColumn.height, room);
                        }
                        contentHeight: naveFolderColumn.height
                        clip: true
                        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
                        interactive: contentHeight > height

                        Column {
                            id: naveFolderColumn
                            width: parent.width

                            Repeater {
                                model: naveFolders
                                delegate: Item {
                                    width: 420
                                    height: 96

                                    Loader {
                                        x: 6
                                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                        width: 34
                                        height: 28
                                        sourceComponent: naveFolderGlyph
                                    }

                                    Text {
                                        x: 56
                                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                        width: 300
                                        text: model.name || ""
                                        elide: Text.ElideRight
                                        textFormat: Text.PlainText
                                        color: naveLayout.ink
                                        font.family: naveLayout.serif
                                        font.pixelSize: 38
                                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                                    }

                                    Text {
                                        anchors.right: parent.right
                                        anchors.rightMargin: 6
                                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                        visible: model.childCount > 0
                                        text: model.childCount
                                        color: naveLayout.ink
                                        font.family: naveLayout.serif
                                        font.pixelSize: 32
                                    }

                                    Rectangle {
                                        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                                        width: parent.width
                                        height: 2
                                        color: naveLayout.ink
                                    }

                                    MouseArea {
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        onClicked: explorerView.openId(model.id, model.type)
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Plate: 420 x 720 slot whose bottom edge is at local 1666
                    // (screen 1786). Shrinks to fit (bottom-anchored) when the folder
                    // list leaves less room; hidden below 360 px.
                    Item {
                        id: navePlate
                        readonly property int bottomY: 1666
                        readonly property int room: {
                            var top = naveFolderList.y + naveFolderList.height + 30;
                            return Math.min(720, navePlate.bottomY - top);
                        }
                        x: 60
                        y: navePlate.bottomY - navePlate.room
                        width: 420
                        height: navePlate.room
                        visible: {
                            if (naveLayout.plateFile === "") return false;
                            if (root.height < naveLayout.footerY) return false;
                            return navePlate.room >= 360;
                        }

                        Image {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
                            verticalAlignment: Image.AlignBottom
                            horizontalAlignment: Image.AlignHCenter
                            asynchronous: true
                            cache: false
                            source: {
                                if (naveLayout.plateFile === "") return "";
                                return naveLayout.dataDir + "plates/" + naveLayout.plateFile;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Text {
                        x: 60
                        y: 1684
                        width: 420
                        visible: navePlate.visible
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        text: naveLayout.plateCaption.toUpperCase()
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                        font.family: naveLayout.serif
                        font.pixelSize: 26
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        font.letterSpacing: 8
                        elide: Text.ElideRight
                    }
                }

                // vertical hairline between aisle and main column (screen y 174 to 1870)
                Rectangle {
                    x: 530
                    y: 54
                    width: 2
                    height: naveLayout.footerY - 54
                    color: naveLayout.ink
                }

                // footer hairline (screen y 1870), x 60 to 1560
                Rectangle {
                    x: 60
                    y: naveLayout.footerY
                    width: 1500
                    height: 2
                    color: naveLayout.ink
                }

                // ============================================= CONTINUE
                Rectangle {
                    id: naveHero
                    x: 560
                    y: 0
                    width: parent.width - 560
                    height: naveLayout.headerY
                    color: "white"

                    Text {
                        x: 30
                        y: 56
                        text: "CONTINUE"
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                        font.family: naveLayout.serif
                        font.pixelSize: 26
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        font.letterSpacing: 8
                    }

                    Text {
                        x: 30
                        y: 110
                        visible: naveHeroRepeater.count === 0
                        text: "Nothing opened yet"
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                        font.family: naveLayout.serif
                        font.italic: true
                        font.pixelSize: 31
                    }

                    Repeater {
                        id: naveHeroRepeater
                        model: naveRecent

                        // One row of three, same columns as the grid (screen y 232)
                        delegate: Item {
                            id: naveRecentItem
                            visible: index < 3
                            x: 30 + index * (naveLayout.colW + naveLayout.colGap)
                            y: 112
                            width: naveLayout.colW
                            height: 144
                            readonly property bool locked: model.isPasswordProtected === true
                            readonly property bool bar: naveLayout.barVisible("" + model.id, model.childIndex, model.childCount, model.filetype)
                            readonly property real frac: naveLayout.progressOf(model.childIndex, model.childCount, model.filetype)

                            Rectangle {
                                id: naveRecentCover
                                x: 0
                                y: 0
                                width: 108
                                height: 144
                                color: "white"
                                border.width: 2.5
                                border.color: naveLayout.ink
                                Image {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    anchors.margins: 2.5
                                    fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                                    asynchronous: true
                                    mipmap: true
                                    source: {
                                        if (index >= 3 || naveRecentItem.locked || !model.thumbnail) return "";
                                        return model.thumbnail;
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            Text {
                                x: 126
                                y: 0
                                width: naveLayout.colW - 126
                                text: model.name || ""
                                textFormat: Text.PlainText
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                maximumLineCount: 1
                                color: naveLayout.ink
                                font.family: naveLayout.serif
                                font.pixelSize: 31
                                font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                            }

                            Text {
                                x: 126
                                y: 44
                                width: naveLayout.colW - 126
                                text: naveLayout.pageText(model.childIndex, model.childCount, model.filetype, naveRecentItem.locked)
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                color: naveLayout.ink
                                font.family: naveLayout.serif
                                font.italic: true
                                font.pixelSize: 25
                            }

                            Item {
                                x: 126
                                y: 144 - 9
                                width: naveLayout.colW - 126
                                height: 9
                                visible: naveRecentItem.bar

                                Rectangle {
                                    y: 7
                                    width: parent.width
                                    height: 2
                                    color: naveLayout.ink
                                }
                                Rectangle {
                                    width: Math.round(parent.width * naveRecentItem.frac)
                                    height: 7
                                    color: naveLayout.ink
                                }
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: explorerView.openId(model.id, model.type)
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // hairline under the row (screen y 416)
                    Rectangle {
                        x: 30
                        y: 296
                        width: naveLayout.mainW
                        height: 2
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                    }
                }

                // ALL DOCUMENTS label over the stock breadcrumb ("My files"),
                // leaving the stock sort control on the right uncovered
                Rectangle {
                    x: naveLayout.mainX - 20
                    y: 300
                    width: 560
                    height: naveLayout.headerY + Values.navigationEntriesHeaderHeight - 300
                    color: "white"

                    Text {
                        x: 20
                        y: 28
                        text: "ALL DOCUMENTS"
                        color: naveLayout.ink
                        font.family: naveLayout.serif
                        font.pixelSize: 26
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        font.letterSpacing: 8
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

END AFFECT

; ===========================================================================
; Grid: folder row collapsed (folders are in the aisle) and cells forced to
; 3 columns of 286 + 56 while Nave is active.
; /qml/device/view/syncserviceexplorer/ContentGridView.qml
AFFECT [[13817727852014686524]]

    ; GridView#gridView > GridView#folderGrid
    TRAVERSE [[7711703004395498]]#[[7713066794570762]] > [[7711703004395498]]#[[8399479237029256267]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL INSERT {
            Component.onCompleted: {
                var stockW = gridView.cellWidth;
                folderGrid.height = Qt.binding(function() {
                    if (typeof naveLayout !== "undefined" && naveLayout.active) return 0;
                    return folderGrid.contentHeight;
                });
                gridView.cellWidth = Qt.binding(function() {
                    if (typeof naveLayout !== "undefined" && naveLayout.active) return naveLayout.colW + naveLayout.colGap;
                    return thumbnailGridSize.gridItemWidth;
                });
                gridView.cellHeight = Qt.binding(function() {
                    if (typeof naveLayout !== "undefined" && naveLayout.active) return 381 + 120 + 46;
                    return thumbnailGridSize.gridItemHeight;
                });
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

END AFFECT

; ===========================================================================
; Document tiles (Nave only): black 2.5 px frame instead of the stock cover frame,
; cover 286 x 381, progress bar, serif title 33 px, italic page line 27 px.
; /qml/device/view/syncserviceexplorer/ContentGridItem.qml
AFFECT [[13817727312169216272]]

    ; ContentItemBase#gridItem
    TRAVERSE ?#[[7713066794115550]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL INSERT {
            Item {
                id: naveTile
                readonly property bool naveOn: {
                    if (typeof naveLayout === "undefined") return false;
                    return naveLayout.active;
                }

                // Set at runtime so the stock values come back whenever Nave is
                // off (delegates are pooled and reused).
                Component.onCompleted: {
                    var tf = _title.font.family;
                    var ts = _title.font.pixelSize;
                    var tw = _title.font.weight;
                    var sf = _infoText.font.family;
                    var ss = _infoText.font.pixelSize;
                    var cm = gridItem.cellMargin;
                    var tbm = _thumbnail.anchors.bottomMargin;
                    var cbm = textColumn.anchors.bottomMargin;
                    _title.font.family = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? "EB Garamond" : tf; });
                    _title.font.pixelSize = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? 33 : ts; });
                    _title.font.weight = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? Font.DemiBold : tw; });
                    _title.color = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? (gridItem.selected ? "#ffffff" : "#000000") : gridItem.itemColor; });
                    _infoText.font.family = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? "EB Garamond" : sf; });
                    _infoText.font.pixelSize = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? 27 : ss; });
                    _infoText.font.italic = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn; });
                    // cover fills the left 286 px of the 342 px cell, 46 px row gap at the bottom
                    _thumbnail.anchors.leftMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? 0 : cm; });
                    _thumbnail.anchors.topMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? 0 : cm; });
                    _thumbnail.anchors.rightMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? naveLayout.colGap : cm; });
                    _thumbnail.anchors.bottomMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? 22 : tbm; });
                    textColumn.anchors.leftMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? 0 : cm; });
                    textColumn.anchors.rightMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? naveLayout.colGap : cm; });
                    textColumn.anchors.bottomMargin = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? 46 : cbm; });
                    border.visible = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn ? false : true; });
                    // PreserveAspectCrop paints past the item unless clipped; wide
                    // covers (e.g. PDFs) spilled out of the narrower Nave cell.
                    _image.clip = Qt.binding(function() { return naveTile.naveOn; });
                }
            }

            // black frame over the cover
            Rectangle {
                id: naveTileFrame
                parent: _thumbnail
                anchors.fill: parent
                visible: naveTile.naveOn
                color: "transparent"
                radius: 5
                border.width: 2.5
                border.color: gridItem.selected ? "#ffffff" : "#000000"
            }

            Item {
                id: naveTileBar
                anchors.top: _thumbnail.bottom
                anchors.topMargin: 6
                anchors.left: _thumbnail.left
                anchors.right: _thumbnail.right
                height: 7
                visible: {
                    if (naveTile.naveOn === false) return false;
                    if (gridItem.type !== Entity.Type.File) return false;
                    return naveLayout.barVisible(gridItem.entityId, gridItem.childIndex, gridItem.childCount, gridItem.filetype);
                }

                Rectangle {
                    y: 5
                    width: parent.width
                    height: 2
                    color: gridItem.itemColor
                }
                Rectangle {
                    height: 7
                    color: gridItem.itemColor
                    width: {
                        if (naveTileBar.visible === false) return 0;
                        return Math.round(parent.width * naveLayout.progressOf(gridItem.childIndex, gridItem.childCount, gridItem.filetype));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

END AFFECT

; ===========================================================================
; Selection "More" menu: Progress bar on/off for the selected documents
; /qml/device/view/navigator/MyFilesMoreFoldout.qml
AFFECT [[2260724785287532277]]

    ; FoldoutOverlay#root > ColumnLayout (contentItem)
    TRAVERSE [[15740235823693067624]]#[[6504254477]] > [[14125623155555875541]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL INSERT {
            ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                id: naveProgressFoldoutItem
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                readonly property var naveRef: {
                    if (typeof treeExplorerComponent === "undefined") return null;
                    if (typeof treeExplorerComponent.naveRef === "undefined") return null;
                    return treeExplorerComponent.naveRef;
                }
                readonly property var ids: {
                    if (typeof actionHeader === "undefined") return [];
                    return actionHeader.selection.selectedIds;
                }
                readonly property bool shown: {
                    if (naveProgressFoldoutItem.naveRef === null) return false;
                    var v = naveProgressFoldoutItem.naveRef.prefsVersion;
                    return naveProgressFoldoutItem.naveRef.allShown(naveProgressFoldoutItem.ids);
                }
                visible: {
                    if (naveProgressFoldoutItem.naveRef === null) return false;
                    if (typeof actionHeader === "undefined") return false;
                    if (actionHeader.selection.hasFolder) return false;
                    return actionHeader.selection.hasPage ? false : true;
                }
                label: "Progress bar"
                iconSource: naveProgressFoldoutItem.shown ? "qrc:/ark/icons/checkbox_checked" : "qrc:/ark/icons/checkbox_unchecked"
                onClicked: {
                    if (naveProgressFoldoutItem.naveRef === null) return;
                    naveProgressFoldoutItem.naveRef.toggleBars(naveProgressFoldoutItem.ids);
                    root.foldoutOverlayClicked();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE

END AFFECT
